references.text: Salt is mentioned as part of all grain offerings, which establishes the significance of the covenant of salt in the context of sacrifices.
Refers to the 'covenant of salt' where God gives David and his descendants the kingdom over Israel forever.
Describes the priests' eternal right to portions of the offerings from the Israelites.
States that the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering are given to Aaron and his sons as a perpetual right.
Refers to the priests and their families' right to eat from the holy offerings.
The immediate context describing the various offerings belonging to the priests.
Confirms the priests' right to portions of the offerings and the firstfruits from the people.
Shows the importance of the hereditary right of the priesthood by excluding those who could not prove their lineage.
